Good — that changes the answer, and I need to correct something I got wrong earlier: **A12 (the XR's chip) is not checkm8-vulnerable.** checkm8 only covers A5 through A11. So palera1n — which I mentioned as an option in my first reply — doesn't actually apply to your device at all. That was my mistake; sorry for the bad lead.

Checked directly against the official Dopamine GitHub repo (opa334/Dopamine), not a mirror or blog:

> "A rootless semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 15.0 - 17.3.1 (arm64e), iOS 15.0 - 18.7.1, 26.0 - 26.0.1 (A12/A13) and iOS 15.0 - 18.7.1 (arm64)."

So for A12 devices specifically, Dopamine's confirmed ceiling is **18.7.1** — with a separate window at 26.0–26.0.1 that doesn't matter here since the XR can't run iOS 26 anyway (it caps out around 18.7.x).

If your XR is sitting at 18.7.9, that's past Dopamine's supported line by a few patch versions. Straight answer: **there's currently no public jailbreak that covers where your device is right now.** Your real options are:

1. **Check if Apple is still signing 18.7.1 or earlier** (ipsw.me shows current signing status) — if so, a restore to that version puts you back in Dopamine's supported range. No SHSH blobs needed for this since it's not a true downgrade below the signing window, just back to a still-signed build.
2. **Wait** — Dopamine's dev team (opa334) moves fairly quickly on extending ranges after new bypasses land; 18.7.9 support could show up.
3. Skip full jailbreak and use **TrollStore** if a compatible version window ever opens for permanent sideloading instead — but per iClarified, TrollStore doesn't cover iOS 18 either right now.

Want me to check what Apple's currently signing for the XR so we know if option 1 is even live?
